findings.title: Native public egress is rejected by the runner admission allowlist
findings.detail: The M2 gateway adds provider={allow_fallbacks:false} to every clean public request. admission() forbids the provider key. Therefore compliant routed public requests fail locally even though the same baseline request is admitted. This is a runner allowlist mismatch with already-existing M2 behavior, not the separate native-tools/metadata integration gap.
findings.reproduction: probes.py: direct admission rejects provider controls; real frozen C RouteSession returns 502 with zero metered calls and zero scripted-provider HTTP requests. No live provider was contacted.
findings.required_fix: Narrowly validate and admit the exact safe provider controls emitted by M2, rejecting unqualified pricing/routing extensions. Add real public RouteSession+nonfixture-admission loopback coverage.

findings.title: Legal comment-prefixed SSE loses final usage and turns successful upstream generation into 502
findings.detail: SSE detection relies on raw.lstrip().startswith(b"data:"). A leading SSE comment or event field takes the JSON-document path, raises JSONDecodeError, and returns ambiguous_upstream_attempt. The real response body is only appended to traces after successful parsing, so on this path raw usage/cost is discarded except for its SHA-256. Failed calls remain unknown, correctly not zero, but a paid successful generation can be wasted and retried.
findings.reproduction: probes.py uses actual loopback HTTP: canonical data-first stream returns 200 and captures prompt=11, completion=5, reasoning=3, cached=7, usage.cost=0.02. The identical stream with : OPENROUTER PROCESSING comment or event: message prefix returns 502 with all usage/cost null. These are synthetic protocol probes, not claimed actual provider recordings.
findings.required_fix: Parse according to response Content-Type with a bounded SSE parser supporting legal comments/event fields; retain bounded raw provider evidence before parsing; test final usage tails, null optional details, error tails and actual authorized OpenRouter recordings.

findings.title: Preflight allows US$10 although allocation B has only US$9.99
findings.detail: validate_live rejects paid_cap_usd only above 10. Independent probe passed validation at 10 using the real reviewed binary. The separately reserved 0.01 makes that exceed this runner allocation. The example 8-dollar setting is within scope, but the claimed allocation guard is too permissive.
findings.required_fix: Enforce the parent-issued remaining allocation (at most 9.99 here), retain the independent earlier reservations, and test exact boundary and larger values. Do not infer approval from truthy review-reference strings.

import json,sys,threading,tempfile,time,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler,ThreadingHTTPServer
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'source'))
from bench.evaluation.live import Egress,create_allocation
from bench.evaluation.run import recover_outcomes
results={};state={'active':0,'maximum':0,'observations':[]};lock=threading.Lock()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
 p=Path(td);allocation=p/'allocation.jsonl'
 class Sink(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
  def log_message(self,*args):pass
  def do_POST(self):
   self.rfile.read(int(self.headers['Content-Length']))
   entries=[json.loads(x) for x in allocation.read_text().splitlines()][1:]
   with lock:
    state['active']+=1;state['maximum']=max(state['maximum'],state['active'])
    state['observations'].append({'reservation_visible_before_provider_handler':any(e['status'] is None for e in entries),'unique_reserved_dispatches':len(set(e['dispatch_id'] for e in entries))})
   time.sleep(.1)
   self.send_response(200);self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(b'{"model":"private-model","usage":{"prompt_tokens":4,"completion_tokens":2}}')
   with lock:state['active']-=1
 server=ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),Sink);thread=threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
 cfg=dict(request_cap=2,paid_cap_usd=9.99,allocation_path=str(allocation),allocation_reference='review-synthetic-only',approval_reference='NO-LIVE',context_limit=65536,upstreams={'private':dict(url=f'http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}/v1',model='private-model',reasoning_semantics='inclusive',tokenizer='synthetic')})
 create_allocation(cfg)
 ep=p/'ep';ep.mkdir()
 egress=Egress(cfg,ep,'task','text-aware')
 # Using real admission path, ONLY loopback scripted endpoint; these are not model results.
 body={'model':'private-model','messages':[{'role':'user','content':'synthetic'}],'max_tokens':32}
 try:
  workers=[threading.Thread(target=egress.forward,args=('private',body,{})) for _ in range(2)]
  for w in workers:w.start()
  for w in workers:w.join()
  results['nonfixture_admission_loopback']={'calls':len(egress.calls),'state':state,'third_request_status':egress.forward('private',body,{})[0]}
  try:create_allocation(cfg)
  except FileExistsError:results['restart_same_allocation_refused']=True
  assignment={'episode_id':'ep','task_id':'task','arm':'text-aware','pair_id':'p'}
  recovered=recover_outcomes(p,[assignment],[])[0]
  results['recovered_after_no_outcome']={'calls':len(recovered['calls']),'success':recovered['success'],'collection_complete':recovered['collection_complete']}
  # Fsync journal failure must prevent all upstream IO.
  another=Egress(dict(cfg,request_cap=10),ep,'task','baseline')
  before=len(state['observations'])
  def fail(call):raise OSError('injected persistence failure')
  another.journal=fail
  try:another.forward('private',body,{})
  except OSError:results['persistence_failure_refuses_network']=len(state['observations'])==before
 finally:server.shutdown();server.server_close();thread.join()
(ROOT/'durability.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
